text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience, and I’d love to help with your essay data scientist project. I understand how important accuracy, detail, and preserving the original format and layout are when working with printed documents, especially when specific sections must be handled carefully. My background in data analysis, data cleaning, and data visualization has trained me to be thorough and precise with complex information.

I have extensive experience working with data in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, and I’m comfortable organizing, checking, and presenting information in a clear and reliable way. For this kind of work, I would focus on careful review, consistency in structure, and making sure the final output reflects the source material faithfully.

One project I completed was Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, where I built a BigQuery-based analysis that joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget. I also completed Parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, where I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey and wrote the findings for the board. That project led to 3 findings being adopted in the next funding plan.

I bring the same level of care to every project, especially when accuracy and presentation matter as much as the content itself. If you need someone who can work methodically, follow instructions closely, and protect the original style and layout of your documents, I’d be glad to help.

I would be happy to discuss your requirements further and make sure the work is completed accurately and on time.
